The '''red-crested aviar swooper''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]]. A red-crested aviar swooper was on display in the [[Atrium]] in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].<ref name="Game" />
